This video shows in the background, a bright minimalist room with light gray walls and a light wooden floor. In the foreground, on the white table, there is a tall cylindrical soda can with a glossy emerald-green anodized aluminum surface, a shiny brushed-silver rim, and a crisp printed paper label, and a black storage basket with a matte woven-plastic texture and visible weave pattern. The robot is instructed to pick up the green soda can and place it into the black woven basket.
